reasons.why: The profile puts 100% of items and chars in class 'other', with 1500 File nodes, 0 mentions, 0 commits and no sensitive labels. No built-in strategy suits it. The records, conversation and media-metadata candidates all scored the same as the default on tune, so none of them has support. The 'code' strategy sets nothing and so keeps the default graph. The default already reaches 0.9847 and no measure shows a loss that a new configuration would fix. Items are short (p50 262, p99 330 chars), so passage and embed lengths do not matter.

Keep the default query keys. The only candidate that moved is bm25_body=4.0, at 0.9949 against 0.9847, a gain of 0.0102. The standard errors are 0.0062 for the default and 0.0036 for the candidate, so two standard errors of the default is 0.0124. The gain is under that, so it counts as noise. I chose the simpler default. The name-light weights also tie with the default at 0.9847.
